column1: # P4-08: ZAP rules for `pnpm scan:zap` (zap-baseline.py -c format: <rule id> TAB <IGNORE|WARN|FAIL> TAB <name>).
# Only IGNORE lines are accepted findings. The scan fails on any other alert of risk Medium or High; Low and
# Informational alerts are printed. Every line below needs a reason. Review the list when ZAP is updated, and when a
# line stops matching anything, delete it.
# 10049 (Non-Storable Content / Storable and Cacheable Content): informational. Pages and the API answer `Cache-Control:
# no-store` on purpose (CSRF tokens, one-time device tokens, THREAT_MODEL T13); the hashed script and stylesheet are
# immutable and cacheable on purpose (P4-03).
# 10112 (Session Management Response Identified): informational; it just notes the session cookie. Its attributes
# (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, no Domain, __Host- over https) are asserted in a real browser by e2e/security.spec.ts and
# e2e/secure.spec.ts.
# 10027 (Suspicious Comments): fires on words such as "admin" and "address" in the two comments of the panel's own script
# (`packages/admin-ui/assets/admin.js`, the optional enhancements). The asset is public by design and holds no secret.
# 10024 (Sensitive Information in URL): the audit and grant filters are named `user`, `token` and `grant`, and carry
# opaque ids (`usr_...`, `grt_...`), never a secret. Credentials are never accepted in a query string (P2-12 matrix);
# the device token appears only in the answer to a form post (`no-store`).
# 10031 (User Controllable HTML Element Attribute): the filter forms echo the query values into `value` attributes. All
# output is escaped by the template layer (scripts/check-ui-escaping.ts), and the CSP forbids inline script with Trusted
# Types, so a reflected value cannot execute. Covered by the escaping tests (P4-03 to P4-07) and by e2e/admin.spec.ts.
# 10099 (Source Code Disclosure - SQL, risk Medium): a false positive on prose. The pattern is `REVOKE ... ON`, and the user
# page says "Their grants and device tokens stay until you revoke them on the grants page." No SQL is served: the panel
# renders fixed sentences and escaped values, and queries are never built from strings (ADR-0012). Re-check the evidence
# of any new instance before keeping this line.
# 10062 (PII Disclosure, risk High): a false positive on random ids. ZAP reads any 12-19 digit run that passes a
# Luhn check as a card number; the audit page shows random hex ids (`usr_...`, `wsp_...`) and dates, and an id whose
# hex happens to be all digits next to a year matched (evidence `559187734026 2026`, PR #106). The product handles no
# card numbers or national ids; personal data shown in the panel is covered by docs/security/logging.md. Re-check the
# evidence of any new instance before keeping this line. Owner confirmed this IGNORE on 2026-10-26.
# 10063 (Permissions Policy Header Not Set, risk Low): reported for the panel's script asset. Every HTML page carries a
# closed `Permissions-Policy` (asserted by e2e/security.spec.ts); a script or stylesheet is not a document that can use
# a browser feature.
# 100000 (client error response code, API scan): ZAP's generated requests hit validation, authorization and 404 paths;
# the admin API answers them with 4xx on purpose.
